newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late selling interest, in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Tuesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were mostly lower, as the market was directionless despite the yen's swings against the U.S. dollar.

"It was totally dead in the morning with low volumes in Japan dampening sentiment. But prices fell across the board in the afternoon on some local selling interest in sympathy with softer prices in Japan," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 fell 1.75 cents to 123.50
March RSS1 fell 1.50 cents to 173.75 Singapore cents
April TSR20 slipped half a cent to 170.50 Singapore cents
